title.en: Compassionate routine and senior pet care

text.en: Pet owners commend the practice for providing affectionate, unhurried care across all life stages, from young puppies to elderly rescue dogs. Clients appreciate gentle dental cleanings and thoughtful palliative treatments that prioritise patient comfort. While one owner disputed lab testing prior to euthanasia, the majority express deep trust.

Veterinarians including Dr. Cortiaus, Dr. Coady, and Dr. William receive consistent praise alongside veterinary technicians and front-office staff. Longtime clients highlight that the clinic maintains high clinical standards following partner retirements. Pet parents describe the team as welcoming, empathetic, and attentive to family questions.

Reviewers emphasize that practitioners take time to explain medical findings, treatment plans, and medication dosages without rushing. Pet owners value detailed email follow-ups and unhurried answers to their questions during appointments. With the exception of one complaint regarding end-of-life protocol communications, advice is praised.

q.en: Do veterinarians perform dental cleanings under anesthesia?

a.en: Yes, clients report smooth dental cleaning procedures performed under anesthesia for their canine companions.

q.en: How does the clinic support compassionate end-of-life care?

a.en: Reviewers note unhurried and empathetic support from veterinarians during difficult euthanasia appointments.

q.en: Are practitioners available for new patient consultations?

a.en: Yes, new residents in Richardson report welcoming first-time visits and comprehensive medical plans for their pets.

q.en: Can appointments be requested through the clinic's website?

a.en: Yes, clients can submit appointment requests and contact the veterinary clinic online.
